# LEUKOCYTOSIS

Most leukocytosis cases are due to infection, but may also be associated with physiological stress, inflammation, medications (e.g.
glucocorticoids), and hematological conditions.
Antimicrobials should be administered if the patient has a syndrome or disease that calls for antimicrobials. Refer to those recommendations for treatment.
Antimicrobials should not be administered solely to treat a patient with leukocytosis and no other sign or symptom of infection.

---

References:

- Wanahita et al., Clinical Infectious Diseases (2002), 34.1585-92
- Reding et al., The American Journal of Medicine (1998), 104.12-16
